title: Reversible Sn<sup>4+</sup>/Sn<sup>0</sup> anode for high-energy-density flow batteries
abstract: Published online: 09 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41557-026-02275-7 Tin-based aqueous flow batteries offer high-capacity anodes due to the potential four-electron redox reactions, but irreversible Sn4+/Sn2+ electrochemistry has hindered battery development. Now it has been shown that iodide-mediated intermediate complexes enable reversible Sn4+/Sn2+ conversion and four-electron Sn4+/Sn0 chemistry, yielding a high anolyte <mark>energy density</mark> and stable long-term operation.
